versions.description_html:
Most people use Copilot like a search box and then wonder why the answers feel random. You have ten files about one project, and the chat window has no idea which of them matter.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • Why Copilot Feels Random Until You Give It a Home
  • What a Copilot Notebook Actually Is
  • How You Set One Up in a Few Minutes
  • What It Does Well Once Your Files Are In
  • The Small Settings That Change Everything
  • Where Your Notebooks Live, and How They Fit Microsoft 365
  • The Limits and the Mistakes to Avoid
  • Notebooks, OneNote, and Pages, in One Breath
  • The Short Version, and One Question for You

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.
